# KeysetEngine Drizzle
> High-performance, database-agnostic keyset pagination and universal search library for Drizzle ORM on Node.js (18+) and Bun.

Full documentation concatenated for LLMs and AI coding assistants:
- [Complete Documentation (Single File)](https://drizzle.keysetengine.aebibtech.com/llms-full.txt): Complete, concatenated Markdown documentation covering architecture, setup, bidirectional pagination, security, database adapters, and API reference.

## Documentation Index

### Getting Started & Guides
- [Overview & Quickstart](https://drizzle.keysetengine.aebibtech.com/guide/getting-started): Installation, schema definition, and route handler usage.
- [Why Keyset Pagination?](https://drizzle.keysetengine.aebibtech.com/guide/why-keyset): Mathematical analysis of O(1) index seeks vs O(N) OFFSET scan degradation.
- [Core Architecture](https://drizzle.keysetengine.aebibtech.com/guide/architecture): Nested boolean disjunction generation and query execution flow.
- [Bidirectional Traversal](https://drizzle.keysetengine.aebibtech.com/guide/bidirectional): Backward/forward navigation, SQL order inversion, and array reversal.
- [Dynamic Search & Stale Cursors](https://drizzle.keysetengine.aebibtech.com/guide/search): Multi-column search with SHA-256 search hash invalidation.
- [Index Design & Optimization](https://drizzle.keysetengine.aebibtech.com/guide/indexing): Composite B-tree indexing rules for PostgreSQL, SQLite, and MySQL.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://drizzle.keysetengine.aebibtech.com/guide/faq): Null handling, relational queries, and Date timestamp formats.

### Security
- [Cryptographic Protection](https://drizzle.keysetengine.aebibtech.com/security/cryptographic-protection): AES-256-GCM + HKDF purpose isolation, tamper detection, and Base64Url fallback.

### Database Adapters
- [PostgreSQL Adapter](https://drizzle.keysetengine.aebibtech.com/databases/postgresql): pgTable integration, ILIKE search, and tsvector full-text search.
- [SQLite & In-Memory](https://drizzle.keysetengine.aebibtech.com/databases/sqlite): sqliteTable integration with bun:sqlite and better-sqlite3.
- [MySQL Adapter](https://drizzle.keysetengine.aebibtech.com/databases/mysql): mysqlTable integration and collation strategies.

### API Reference
- [Core API](https://drizzle.keysetengine.aebibtech.com/api/core): createKeysetConfig, paginateKeyset, buildKeysetClause, formatKeysetPage.
- [Security API](https://drizzle.keysetengine.aebibtech.com/api/security): CryptoCursorProtector, Base64UrlCursorProtector, computeSearchHash.
- [Search Strategies API](https://drizzle.keysetengine.aebibtech.com/api/search-strategies): likeSearchStrategy, ilikeSearchStrategy, postgresTsVectorSearchStrategy.
